sourceReviews.review: For any actual finite open cover of any topological space and any abelian sheaf F,positive exactness of the SAME native FULL Cech complex plus positive actual native SHEAF H vanishing on ALL original finite intersections implies ALL positive actual native SHEAF H(F) vanishes. The actual free-open Ext/local-H ADDITIVE comparison is constructed in EVERY degree without a Cech,affine,Noetherian or duality hypothesis. Restriction of injectives is used only as flasque/acyclic,not claimed injective. This is a VANISHING CRITERION with exact Cech/local hypotheses,not a general all-degree Cech/H isomorphism,not an ordered/full comparison,not geometric Serre existence. Original4.1/4.2/main and canonical identification remain OPEN.
